- Keyboard: corner swipes on the number keys with presets (old phone letters, edit functions, symbols, maths; off by default); an Old phone keyboard theme (silver keys); the Passwords (vault) tile in the ⋮ menu
- Fixed the crash "Using WebView from more than one process" (Game Hub opening while YTXTube ran): each extra process has its own WebView data folder
- Keyboard: new themes (Midnight, Forest, Rosé, Sunset, High contrast, Colour-blind safe); abbreviations and chemical names are known (tbmm → TBMM, tubitak → TÜBİTAK, h2o → H2O, amid stays); the Whisper model downloads from the keyboard settings; a calculator ("12*5=" answers, setting, off by default)
- YTX cinema view: the buttons and the bar sit on the picture's frame, the page darkens as it is pulled and the view fades in; SponsorBlock self-promotion is skipped by default
- Keyboard (from WM Keyboard): settings search, typing speed test, split gap, key corners and icon family over the theme, encrypted backups (password), works before the first unlock, semantic emoji search, GIF search (Tenor, no key needed), codes from notifications, units and digit systems, language per app, media keys, power saving, a few easter eggs
- Music: the Player settings page sits on the blurred cover when Blended is on; YouTube Music and Spotify cards at the top of the library; the library no longer shows over the cover while the player is pulled down
- Keyboard: a held key shows what its hold does (Clipboard, Voice ...) and a corner swipe shows the symbol or key it will type before the finger lifts
- Music: songs from YouTube Music and Spotify (library cards and search) now play inside the music player itself, not in YTXTube; Alt+key on the keyboard no longer types the key twice, and a waiting Ctrl/Alt/Win shows what each letter does
- Files: a code editor (Sora Editor with the VS Code grammars from Xed-Editor): the language is found from the name or the first lines (Python, HTML, JS/TS, JSON, XML, CSS, Kotlin, Java, C/C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Shell, SQL, YAML and about 30 more), colours, line numbers, block lines, folding while reading, search and replace, undo/redo, a symbol bar; a code file opens in it on a tap and any text file from its menu ("Code editor")
- Notes: a "Code" mode in a note's + menu: a small coloured editor in the note with a button at its top right that opens the whole editor
- Keyboard: web addresses typed as site.com stay together (the ending no longer starts a new sentence with a capital)
- Downloads: a whole season (Series and movies) looks for the episodes' streams three at a time, can no longer get stuck (the button always comes back) and says why when nothing starts; YTXTube's Downloads page has a Pulse tab that lists the Pulse app's own downloads (series, movies, files) with progress, plus buttons for Series and movies and All downloads
- Series and movies: the play buttons now also watch torrent streams (the engine's own small server on the phone hands the player the file as its pieces arrive); it fetches the first pieces first and says what it is doing
